proposed.text: What is the IBC sprinkler increase factor (Is) for a MULTI-STORY building with a full NFPA 13 sprinkler system, and what is the factor for a SINGLE-STORY building with the same system?
proposed.rationale: Original question was already source-correct and substantive; the prior edit (source-audited-article-batch-048) was degenerate, with 1-character garbage in 3 of 4 option text fields and a nonsensical rationale. Restored the original verbatim. Original source rationale: Option A applies the same factor regardless of building height — this is the most common error. The distinction between single-story and multi-story sprinkler bonuses reflects fire physics: in a single-story building, sprinklers control the fire in the horizontal plane without the complication of vertical smoke and flame travel through multiple floors. The 1.00-point difference between Is = 2.00 and Is = 3.00 is significant in area calculations.
proposed.explanation: Option A applies the same factor regardless of building height — this is the most common error.
